description: Pi crashes mid-run: a prompt starting with 'Run' starts a tool, prints a line, then the process exits with code 1. A prompt starting with 'fill' gets a 40-line answer, so the transcript overflows the pane and is pinned to the bottom. A prompt ending in 'picture' is answered after 1.5 s (nothing else moves on screen right after it's sent). Other prompts get the default answer. The extension command /die makes Pi exit with code 3 while idle (a crash between turns).
